title: HTTP batch
description: Body of POST /readings: one batch, i.e. one engine's readings for one second of a flight. This schema checks the envelope only, and an envelope that fails it rejects the whole batch. Items of `readings` only have to be objects, so one corrupt reading (missing field, wrong type) cannot reject the batch. Ingest checks each item on its own against #/$defs/reading, then checks the unit against sensors.yaml and the timestamp against the stale/future skew limits, and drops each corrupt reading individually.

second.description: Epoch second of the flight that this batch covers.

reading.description: One reading. Ingest validates each item of `readings` against this; a failure makes that reading corrupt. Ingest also marks it corrupt unless: ts is within [second*1000, second*1000+999] (so stored offsets from `second` are 0-999); sensorId starts with `<engineId>.`; the sensor type is in sensors.yaml; unit matches that type; and ts is within the stale/future skew of ingest's clock (N/M). Unknown extra fields are ignored, not corrupt.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds on the vehicle (simulator) clock.
